questions.q: What are you actually looking for?

results.name: It is complicated
results.headline: True, and you would still swipe.
results.body: Some months it is the best thing you have done and some months you would hand it to anybody. Both are true at once.
results.cost: Complicated is only a problem when you stop being honest about which month it is.

results.name: Looking for long term
results.headline: You are building something to keep.
results.body: You are not in this for the exit and you have turned down the fast version at least once.
results.cost: Patience and avoidance look identical from the outside.

results.name: Will break your heart, then make you stronger
results.headline: You have been through it.
results.body: You have already survived the version of this that ends everything, and you are still here, changed.
results.cost: You have started to wear the scar tissue as the qualification.

results.name: Available 24/7
results.headline: Which is not the flex you think.
results.body: You answer at midnight and on holiday, and it is genuinely part of why customers stay.
results.cost: The thing that made you loved is the thing that will make you leave.

results.name: Financially unstable, emotionally rewarding
results.headline: Painfully accurate.
results.body: The money is not the reason and it is a good job too. You would find it hard to explain to anyone doing this for money.
results.cost: Rewarding does not pay a bill and it never has.
